# mergeah_tool_pack_standard_entity_rule (Resource)

Manage a Tool Pack standard entity rule override. Destroy deletes the override and restores organization inheritance. inbound_action is retained when absent from GET responses.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Configure the provider as shown in examples/provider/provider.tf.
resource "mergeah_tool_pack_standard_entity_rule" "example" {
  tool_pack_id    = "a6d21b9d-6235-4f85-b175-0799fc4bfed1"
  entity_type     = "EMAIL_ADDRESS"
  is_active       = true
  inbound_action  = "REDACT"
  outbound_action = "BLOCK"
}
```

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:
